The census found open/draft, head f206961be43b4594126d63f2dc6d3660518b0557, updated_at 2026-10-20T19:46:39Z — unchanged, not merged. Log it, next due ~18:24.

prompt: The GitHub MCP server no longer advertises get_pull_request, the tool prior runs used for the #73 census. How do I verify the PR now?
chosen: Adapt to the live catalog: list_pull_requests is the advertised read tool, so call it with state=all perPage=100 — the unfiltered census from the run-387 lesson — and read #73 out of the returned set (open/draft/head/updated_at all verified). Never treat a filtered list as a verify source; the full enumeration is what anchors the negative and positive claims alike.
rejected: Retry get_pull_request a few times, then declare the census failed and the PR's status unknown.
